card.name: Of after treatment in GERD dosing tables
card.fires_on: The word "of" (or "omatic" in "Symptomatic") right after a heading such as Treatment, Healing or Relief in acid-reflux dosage tables. It also fires on "with" after "pediatric patients" in the same dosing sections.

modes.label: Of after indication heading
modes.description: The word "of" after Treatment, Healing or Relief at the start of an indication row naming GERD or esophagitis.

modes.label: Inside Symptomatic
modes.description: The middle piece of "Symptomatic" before GERD in an indication row.

modes.label: With after pediatric patients
modes.description: "with" following pediatric patients in a dosage sentence.

card.plain: It marks the spot in a pediatric acid-reflux dosing table where a condition name like GERD or erosive esophagitis comes next.
